cards.ex: The coral reef was teeming with life; it was amazing!
cards.exUz: Marjon riflari hayotga to'la edi; bu ajoyib edi!
cards.uzDef: Hudud juda ko'p o'simlik va hayvonlar bilan to'ldirilgan.

cards.ex: It's important to protect animals in the wild.
cards.exUz: Yovvoyi tabiatdagi hayvonlarni himoya qilish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Qafasda emas, tabiatda, erkin yashovchi hayvon.

cards.ex: The panda's natural habitat is the bamboo forests of China.
cards.exUz: Panda'ning tabiiy muhiti Xitoy bambuk o'rmonlari.
cards.uzDef: Hayvon yoki o'simlikning tabiiy yashash joyi.

cards.ex: The old oak tree weathered the storm without breaking.
cards.exUz: Qadimgi eman daraxti bo'rondan sinmasdan o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatdan muvaffaqiyatli o'tib ketish.

cards.ex: The species is on the verge of extinction.
cards.exUz: Bu tur yo'q bo'lib ketish yoqasida.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa sodir bo'lishiga yaqin, arafasida.

cards.ex: Our efforts to clean the beach are just a drop in the ocean.
cards.exUz: Sohilni tozalashga urinishlarimiz dengizdan tomchi xolos.
cards.uzDef: Kichik va ahamiyatsiz miqdor, katta muammoga yechim emas.

cards.ex: The company decided to branch out into eco-tourism.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya ekoturizmga tarmoqlanishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi joylarga yoki sohalarga kengaymoq.

cards.ex: We need to understand the lay of the land before building.
cards.exUz: Qurilishdan oldin hudud tuzilishini tushunishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hududning joylashuvi va xususiyatlari haqida ma'lumot.

cards.ex: The cherry blossoms were in full bloom last spring.
cards.exUz: O'tgan bahorda gilos gullari to'liq ochilgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Gullar to'liq ochilgan, eng chiroyli holatida.

cards.ex: Visiting the mountains was a breath of fresh air after city life.
cards.exUz: Tog'larga tashrif buyurish shahar hayotidan keyin toza havo edi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va tetiklantiruvchi narsa yoki tajriba.

cards.ex: Pollution is taking its toll on the environment.
cards.exUz: Ifloslanish atrof-muhitga ta'sir qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Nima bo'lsa ham salbiy ta'sir qoldirmoq.

cards.ex: I need to escape this concrete jungle and go to the countryside.
cards.exUz: Men bu tosh o'rmondan qochib, qishloqqa borishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Binolar va yo'llar bilan to'ldirilgan shahar.

cards.ex: Sometimes I just want to get back to nature and go camping.
cards.exUz: Ba'zida men shunchaki tabiatga qaytib, lager qurmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Tabiat bilan bog'lanish, tabiatda vaqt o'tkazish.

cards.ex: The bear seems to be under the weather; it hasn't eaten in days.
cards.exUz: Ayiq o'zini kasal his qilyapti; bir necha kundan beri hech narsa yemadi.
cards.uzDef: Biroz kasal, o'zini yaxshi his qilmaslik.

cards.ex: It's survival of the fittest in the animal kingdom.
cards.exUz: Hayvonot dunyosida eng moslashganlar omon qoladi.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatda eng moslashgan turlar omon qoladi.

cards.ex: They are cutting down trees to build a new road.
cards.exUz: Ular yangi yo'l qurish uchun daraxtlarni kesishyapti.
cards.uzDef: Daraxtni kesib tashlash.

cards.ex: The disease could wipe out the entire population.
cards.exUz: Kasal butun populyatsiyani yo'q qilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Butunlay yo'q qilmoq, yer yuzidan o'chirmoq.

cards.ex: The dying coral reef was a wake-up call about ocean pollution.
cards.exUz: O'layotgan marjon riflari okean ifloslanishi haqida ogohlantirish edi.
cards.uzDef: Muammo haqida ogohlantirish, e'tiborni jalb qilish.

cards.ex: The rainforest is a fragile ecosystem that needs protection.
cards.exUz: Tropik o'rmon - himoya qilish kerak bo'lgan nozik ekotizim.
cards.uzDef: Osonlik bilan buzilishi mumkin bo'lgan ekotizim.

cards.ex: We need to increase conservation efforts to save endangered species.
cards.exUz: Yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostida turgan turlarni saqlab qolish uchun muhofaza harakatlarini kuchaytirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatni muhofaza qilishga qaratilgan harakatlar.

cards.ex: Sustainable practices are better for the environment in the long run.
cards.exUz: Barqaror amaliyotlar uzoq muddatda atrof-muhit uchun yaxshiroq.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida, oxir-oqibat.

cards.ex: Dinosaurs died out millions of years ago.
cards.exUz: Dinozavrlar million yillar oldin qirilib ketgan.
cards.uzDef: Butunlay yo'qolib ketmoq, tirik qolmaslik.

cards.ex: He felt the call of the wild and decided to hike the Appalachian Trail.
cards.exUz: U yovvoyilik chaqirig'ini his qildi va Appalachian Trail bo'ylab yurishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatga bo'lgan kuchli istak, sarguzashtga intilish.

cards.ex: Recycling can make a difference in reducing pollution.
cards.exUz: Qayta ishlash ifloslanishni kamaytirishda o'zgarish kiritishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga ijobiy ta'sir ko'rsatmoq.

cards.ex: My grandmother has a green thumb; her garden is beautiful.
cards.exUz: Mening buvim yaxshi bog'bon; uning bog'i juda chiroyli.
cards.uzDef: O'simliklarni yaxshi o'stira oladigan qobiliyat.

cards.ex: We need to nip this invasive species in the bud before it spreads.
cards.exUz: Bu invaziv turni tarqalishidan oldin kurakda qoldirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni boshlanishidayoq to'xtatish.

cards.ex: Identifying the bird species was a walk in the park for the expert.
cards.exUz: Qush turlarini aniqlash mutaxassis uchun sayrdek oson edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda oson narsa, qiyinchiliksiz bajariladigan ish.

cards.ex: She felt at one with nature while meditating in the forest.
cards.exUz: U o'rmonda meditatsiya qilayotganda tabiat bilan uyg'unlikda his qildi.
cards.uzDef: Tabiat bilan yaqin va uyg'un his qilish.

cards.ex: The new plants will take root quickly in this fertile soil.
cards.exUz: Yangi o'simliklar bu unumdor tuproqda tezda ildiz otadi.
cards.uzDef: Boshlamoq, yangi joyda rivojlanmoq.

cards.ex: We should let nature take its course and not interfere.
cards.exUz: Biz tabiatga o'z yo'li bilan borishiga ruxsat berishimiz va aralashmasligimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatda sodir bo'ladigan tabiiy jarayonlar.
